front.title: IPFIX Export of RoCEv2 Sequence Observations

abstract.t:
This document specifies an IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) metering and export profile for bounded Packet Sequence Number (PSN) observations on provisioned RoCEv2 Reliable Connection SEND and RDMA WRITE request streams. It defines cumulative observations of skipped, subsequently observed, expired, repeated, and unclassified sequence positions, with explicit observation epochs and qualification flags.
The profile requires complete observation of the provisioned stream and defines no packet-loss estimator, retransmission detector, or congestion-control action. Twelve Information Elements describe the observation state. Existing RoCEv2 header Information Elements identify the monitored stream.
